title: JANUS Linear A R3 fresh transcription/parser source provenance audit

independence_ladder.definition: Different file format, website, model, dictionary, or wrapper that directly consumes the current digital baseline. Not independent evidence.

Independent software/data-entry/drawing pipeline, but transcription decisions ultimately derive from the same printed/editorial corpus tradition. Useful for parser/encoding validation, not external transcription replication.

Different editors/edition with meaningful transcription decisions, but substantial dependence or referential continuity with GORILA or the same underlying editorial tradition. Potentially useful if overlap and provenance can be frozen.

Independently curated transcription decisions for overlapping inscriptions, with provenance sufficient to demonstrate that the digital readings were not copied or mechanically transformed from the current baseline. Required for external transcription replication.

current_baseline.name: Linear A Explorer / lineara.xyz
current_baseline.editorial_base: GORILA transcriptions plus George Douros tabulation/interpretation

candidates.name: SigLA — The Signs of Linear A
candidates.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for dataset and drawings

provenance.editorial_layer: independent palaeographic drawings, contextual sign-function decisions, database modelling and software by Salgarella/Castellan
provenance.recent_updates: SigLA continues adding documents under its own editorial maintenance, including 2026 additions
provenance.independence_limit: The project explicitly presents GORILA as the standard corpus and documents that all GORILA tablets were imported. This does not establish independent transcription of overlapping legacy inscriptions.

best_use_in_JANUS: typed-token boundary validation independent of lineara.xyz software pipeline
candidates.forbidden_claim: Do not call agreement with SigLA external transcription replication until overlapping readings are shown to be independently transcribed rather than inherited from GORILA.

candidates.name: Minoan linguistic resources: The Linear A Digital Corpus
candidates.machine_readable_status: EPI-DOC/XML PIPELINE DOCUMENTED; CURRENT PUBLIC COMPLETE CORPUS ENDPOINT NOT CONFIRMED

provenance.collection_start: John G. Younger digital syllabic transcriptions
provenance.normalization: automatic conversion toward GORILA codes and Unicode followed by manual comparison with GORILA
provenance.independence_limit: Younger is explicitly described as relying primarily on GORILA; therefore this is a separate encoding pipeline, not an independent transcription baseline.

candidates.name: A Machine-Readable Dictionary for the Corpus of Linear-A Script

provenance.independence_limit: The paper identifies Hogan & Douros Linear A Explorer as the online database used for the corpus, so it is directly derivative from the current digital baseline.

candidates.name: Recueil des inscriptions en linéaire A — Supplément 1

provenance.scope: supplementary corpus of documents discovered/published after the original GORILA period
provenance.methodological_relation: authors explicitly continue the GORILA corpus methodology
provenance.independence_value: important independent editorial work for newly added documents, but not a fresh independent transcription of the legacy overlapping GORILA corpus

provenance.value: separate edited print corpus and transnumeration tradition
provenance.independence_limit: modern electronic-corpus literature notes that later corpora refer closely to GORILA volume/page conventions; a source-specific digital transcription and overlap audit are required before treating CTLA as L3.

provenance.digital_project: planned/on-going EpiDoc representation of TMT transcriptions and commentary
provenance.independence_value: different editorial corpus and encoding project from lineara.xyz, potentially valuable if a recoverable frozen dataset is found
provenance.current_limit: public project directories found in current searches remain descriptions/in-preparation pages rather than a verified downloadable complete corpus

candidates.name: Linear A Corpus — NTU handmade reproductions

provenance.public_description: handmade reproductions accompanied by original pictures
provenance.independence_limit: current evidence does not establish that the encoded readings were produced independently of Younger/GORILA-derived digital resources; related research from the same programme explicitly uses those traditions

R3_result.next_action: Freeze a SigLA cross-digitization/parser audit as R3A while separately pursuing L2/L3 CTLA/TMT/RILA machine-readable acquisition. SigLA agreement may validate software/encoding robustness but must not be promoted to external transcription replication.

new_method_connections.name: SOURCE_INDEPENDENCE_IS_LAYERED_NOT_BINARY
new_method_connections.statement: A source can be independent at software, digitization, palaeographic drawing, editorial, or primary transcription layers. Replication claims must name which layer is independent.

new_method_connections.name: DIFFERENT_FILE_FORMAT_DOES_NOT_CREATE_INDEPENDENT_EVIDENCE
new_method_connections.statement: Excel, TEI/XML, JSON, or a new website can remain derivative evidence if the encoded readings are mechanically or editorially inherited from the same transcription baseline.

new_method_connections.name: CROSS_DIGITIZATION_REPLICATION_CAN_TEST_PARSER_ARTIFACTS_WITHOUT_TESTING_TRANSCRIPTION_INDEPENDENCE
new_method_connections.statement: Independent digitization of the same print corpus is still useful: agreement can falsify software/parser-specific artifacts even though it cannot establish external epigraphic replication.

roadmap.goal: Freeze SigLA dataset/source version, implement a SigLA-specific parser without mwenge assumptions, and compare document/sign/word boundaries and typed-token identities on overlapping inscriptions.
Locate or obtain machine-readable CTLA/TMT/RILA data or independently transcribe a predeclared overlapping subset from an alternate print/editorial corpus.
Source-specific adapter under research/linear_a/ that preserves disagreements rather than coercing them to the mwenge representation.
Freeze locked transforms and hypotheses before any true external transcription replication test.
